mapper.select: SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(r.order_staff_type, 'NONE')) > 1 THEN 'CONFLICT' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(r.order_staff_type, 'NONE')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(r.order_staff_type, 'NONE')) ELSE 'NONE' END AS default_type FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM salon_store_user su WHERE su.user_id = u.id AND su.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND su.store_id = #{storeId} AND su.deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ar JOIN sys_role role_scope ON role_scope.id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.user_id = u.id AND role_scope.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_scope.deleted = 0 AND role_scope.status = 1 AND role_scope.code IN ('TENANT_ADMIN', 'ROOT')) ) GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY name, u.id
